name: glyphite
description: Glyphite: an AI-first ASCII game engine, its games, and the site that serves them.

scripts.serve: node tools/glyphite.mjs build && node tools/glyphite.mjs serve
scripts.dev: node tools/glyphite.mjs build && wrangler d1 migrations apply glyphite --local && wrangler dev --local-upstream localhost:8787
